en: <CLT=cltMIND>Miu is extremely unpleasant...

<CLT=cltMIND>She may be a genius who invents useful stuff,
but that doesn't give her a free pass.

<CLT=cltMIND>We got into an argument last time, but this
time, I'll set her straight!
<CLT=cltMIND>With that in mind, I invited Miu again today...

You wanna be with me that badly, huh?
Didn't realize you were such a clinger!
<CLT=cltMIND>She says that, but she's smiling...

<CLT=cltMIND>That reminds me...when we argued the other day,
she looked pretty happy. What's up with that?
Hey, Miu. Can I ask you something?
Wh-What is it?
Do you *want* to talk to people, Miu?
Huh? I'm talkin' to you right now.

Are your ears as worthless as that flat
chest of yours?

See, that! Why do you always have to say
more than what's necessary!?

Ah! Wh-What do you mean, more than
what's necessary...?

You should stop saying things that could
hurt other people's feelings.

Hey, I'm just sayin' what I'm already thinkin'!
Nothin' I say is wasted words!

Only little kids can get away with saying
the first thing that pops into their head!
Do you know who the fuck I am?

When you're Miu fuckin' Iruma, you can get
away with sayin' all kinds of awful shit!
Hoo-yeah! Cuz I fuckin' rule!
<CLT=cltMIND>And who's letting you get away with this!?

Geez, I'm surprised you were able to attend
school like that.

School's not a place for smart people.
Waste of time if you ask me...

But if I dropped out, all the dudes who whack
it to my pictures would get so lonely!

<CLT=cltMIND>...What do I even say to that?
Does she even have friends at all?

Hey, do you have any friends that you can argue
with, like what we did the other day?
Wh-What if I don't...?
<CLT=cltMIND>I knew it... That's why she seemed happy...

H-Hey! It's not like I don't have any friends!
I just don't talk to plebs like you, is all!

So in other words, you don't have any.
Well, it's obvious why, when you're like that.

Shut up! I don't need you worrying about
me!
Well, I am!

If you continue like this, then you won't be
able to live your life to the fullest, Miu.

Ha, hahaha... The hell are you talkin' about?
I'm an inventor, remember?

Even as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Inventor<CLT=cltNORMAL>, you're only
useful to people who need your inventions.

Hngh!? Y-You just hit me below the belt...
right in the lady balls...

Anyway! While we're here, I think you should
get used to talking to people!
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
I-I'm tired...

<CLT=cltMIND>I tried to have a normal conversation with Miu,
but I'm sure I used a year's worth of patience.
Hah-hahaha! Not too shabby, Kaede!

I think I understand how to deal with plebs
like you now.
Well, at least my hard work paid off...somewhat.

Your meddling was unnecessary, even
creepy...but hey, I guess I'm sorta grateful!

Maybe I'll invent a gadget to breathe some life
into that flat chest of yours! Hah-haha!
You didn't learn anything!
<CLT=cltMIND>Geez, what am I gonna do with this girl...?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Miu's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Miu, I returned
to my room.
